build: Modwerk's linker (scripts/link-image.mjs): the Modwerk base's voices variant 879c6c23 + this folder's SY RAVE 0.1.0-experimental alone, on stock OS 1.74, --version RV07

unit.method: RAM-booted over the development base's USB link (rytm_link.py ramboot, image crc de8e3c72); nothing written to the flash

conditions: The unit's own kit K001 on the SD track, sequencer stopped, GLOBAL > REMOTE CTRL on. Keys and encoders sent over the link (rytm_link.py steps).

captures.plan: cd sdk/machines/analog-rytm-mkii/tools; rytm_link.py steps 'FUNC+SRC w600 DOWN*26 UP*3 w500 png:machine-list.png' (the SD track; the cursor from SD HARD down past DISABLE, then up to SY RAVE)
cd sdk/machines/analog-rytm-mkii/tools; rytm_link.py steps 'YES w2800 png:synth-page.png' (right after the machine-list plan)
cd sdk/machines/analog-rytm-mkii/tools; rytm_link.py steps 'encC+4 w40' forty times, then 'w100 png:chord-name.png' (after a few larger turns had left CHD at 0)
